subject: Secure profile fingerprinting and handback for Whistic sync
messages:
From: Samantha Jones <sam.jones@acmehealth.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Onboarding Team <onboard@acmehealth.com>
Date: 2026-04-15T14:03:00-07:00
Subject: Whistic canonical fields + signed proof (initial request)

Hi David,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. To finish our review we need a canonical mapping of Redwood's Whistic profile fields to our SIG/CAIQ schema, plus a signed-proof manifest (hashes + signatures) for the artifacts you upload. Specifically we're looking for:  

- A short CSV that maps Redwood Whistic field names to our canonical set (serviceAccount -> identity.owner etc.).
- The SOC 2 summary + pointer to the full report (we can receive a pointer if the report remains gated).
- An integrity manifest (file-level SHA256 + signature) for any S3 proof bundle you upload.

Can you let me know the target path you will use in Whistic and whether you will include ephemeral temp-credentials evidence? If possible we need the upload and the manifest by Friday EOD PT.

Attachments: SOC2-Summary-Acme.pdf (placeholder for our reviewers)

Regards,
Samantha Jones
Information Security, Acme Health
From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Jones <sam.jones@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-04-15T16:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Whistic canonical fields + signed proof (initial request)

Samantha —

Thanks for the clear list. We'll take point on the mapping and the manifest. Plan below:  

1) Priyom will produce a draft CSV mapping for your canonical fields and attach it here. Please highlight any fields you expect to be treated as PII or regulated metadata.
2) We'll prepare a signed-proof manifest (SHA256 + RSA-PSS) for the S3 bundle and upload the bundle to a pre-signed Whistic asset link.
3) Naomi will perform the final evidence upload and post the Whistic URL once complete.

A couple of clarifying asks:  
- When you say "serviceAccount", do you expect the mapping to include both the account identifier and the key rotation cadence field (we can surface both as separate mapped columns).
- Do you want the manifest to include per-file last-modified timestamps in ISO format? We typically include those.

I've attached an initial draft of the field map (whistic_field_map_draft.csv) for your review. Priyom — please take lead on the mapping and the manifest generation.

Thanks,
David
Head of Platform Security Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: whistic_field_map_draft.csv
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Jones <sam.jones@acmehealth.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-04-16T09:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Whistic canonical fields + signed proof (mapping + manifest plan)

Hi all —

Taking this on. Summary of work items and ETA:  

- Field map: I completed a first-pass mapping of our Whistic attributes to Acme's canonical SIG/CAIQ columns. The draft includes columns: whistic_field, canonical_field, pii_flag, retention_days, examples. (see attached CSV). ETA: same day.
- Manifest generation: I'll produce a signed manifest that includes filename, size, sha256, iso_last_modified, and a signature block. Signature will be RSA-PSS (2048) and I'll include the public key fingerprint in the manifest header. ETA: tomorrow morning.
- Upload choreography: Naomi will create the Whistic profile attachment with the S3 pointer to s3://redwood-evidence/acme/2026-04-whistic-manifest.json. We'll also post the pre-signed upload to Whistic and provide the link to your review team before finalizing.

A note on ephemeral creds: we prefer not to include long-lived secrets inside the evidence bundle. If you require temp credential proofs, we'll provide an ephemeral key screenshot + KMS rotation policy PDF as separate artifacts.

Next actions: Samantha, can you confirm whether Acme's review team requires per-file notarization timestamps (UTC) in addition to last-modified? If yes, we'll add unix epoch + ISO.

Thanks,
Priyom
Security Engineering
Redwood Inference

Attachments: signed-proof-manifest.json (to be generated), whistic_field_map_draft.csv
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Jones <sam.jones@acmehealth.com>
Cc: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-04-17T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Whistic canonical fields + signed proof (upload complete)

Samantha —

Quick update: we completed the evidence upload and the signed manifest is live. Details below and links for your reviewers:  

- Whistic profile: https://app.whistic.com/profile/78821 (artifact section: "Proofs / 2026-04-Manifest")
- S3 manifest pointer: s3://redwood-evidence/acme/2026-04-whistic-manifest.json
- Manifest filename: signed-proof-manifest.json (contains per-file sha256, size, iso_last_modified, signature and public key fingerprint)

We included both the serviceAccount identifier and a separate key_rotation_cadence field in the mapping CSV. Per your ask, filenames include ISO timestamps and unix epoch. If the review team wants notarization timestamps (UTC) in a separate column we can re-run the manifest generation and append those.

HubSpot reference: ACME-PLG-2026-093.

Thanks,
Naomi Feldman
Platform Trust — Redwood Inference
